subject: Evaluation acceptance runbook, blocker handling, and final KPI definitions
messages:
From: Alicia Mendez <alicia.mendez@sleepwellhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@consulting-partner.io>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot evaluation and next steps – MAP request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profile and deterministic pricing were helpful context. We'd like to move forward with a 6-week evaluation focused on two use cases: (1) patient triage summarization and (2) clinical note embedding for search. Procurement is on board pending a short mutual action plan and a clear acceptance checklist.

Can you share a short MAP including: milestones, acceptance criteria per use case, an explicit list of blocker scenarios and an owner for each, and a final decision cutover date? Procurement wants to see the SLA and audit log behavior called out.

We'd prefer an initial draft by Monday so we can review before our internal steering committee on Wednesday.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Mendez
Head of Digital Experience
SleepWell Health

Attachment: onboarding-slide-deck.pdf (slide deck referenced in demo)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Mendez <alicia.mendez@sleepwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and next steps – MAP request

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a draft MAP (SW-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) and an acceptance checklist (eval-acceptance-checklist.md). High level summary below so it's easy for your steering committee:⠀

1) Timeline: 6-week evaluation starting Jun 15 -> Jul 27.
2) Decision gates: week 2 (integration smoke test), week 4 (quality & latency pass/fail), final week (business sign-off).
3) Acceptance criteria (short):
   - Triage summarization: F1 >= 0.72 on clinical label set; median generation latency <= 120ms (p50) at target TPS.
   - Embeddings: nearest-neighbor recall@10 >= 0.65 and end-to-end search latency <= 180ms.
   - Security: SOC2 evidence for logging + dedicated VPC connectivity validated by procurement.
4) Blocker runbook (summary):
   - Data ingress failure -> owner: Marissa (devops), mitigation: retry + pre-signed upload backstop.
   - Model regression (quality drop >10%) -> owner: Ben (ML eng), mitigation: automatic rollback to pinned model + preserve logs for eval.
   - Audit-log gaps -> owner: Naomi (security), mitigation: forward logs to S3 and open immediate investigation with engineering SLA of 24h.

Please review the attached cells where I spelled out test cases and success thresholds. If this aligns, we'll convert the workbook to a mutual action plan with owners and dates.

Karthik
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SW-MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, eval-acceptance-checklist.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and next steps – MAP request

Looping in a few specifics for test ownership and observability hooks. Notes below — I'll add these to the MAP workbook:⠀

- Integration smoke (Week 2): Redwood will provide a connector guide + Postman collection. Owner: Marissa. Success = data ingestion of sample set (10k records) with 0 dropped messages.
- Latency load profile (Week 4): we'll run a synthetic replay at target TPS (5 TPS sustained) and measure both p50/p95. Owner: Ben. Success = p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 400ms. If p95 > 400ms, automatic throttle policy will be applied and we escalate to infra.
- Quality evaluation (Week 4): use SleepWell's labeled sample (n=1,200). We'll run blind evals and produce a short report with examples of failure modes. Owner: Ben.
- Security & procurement asks: Naomi, can you confirm the SOC2 artifacts and provide the audit log retention policy in the MAP?

Two additional asks for Alicia: please confirm the dataset owners for the labeled sample and whether PHI will be present in the test set — this affects the on-prem vs. hosted decision.

-Marissa
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Mendez <alicia.mendez@sleepwellhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot evaluation and next steps – MAP request

Alicia — quick security confirmation: we can produce the following artifacts during the evaluation:

- SOC 2 Type II summary report (redacted) + evidence index (will share via secure link).
- Audit log retention: default 90 days in hosted, 1 year on Dedicated/Private. For evaluation we can preserve a 180-day temp window for troubleshooting (requires PO addendum).
- KMS integration: test key support is available; production keys need KMS onboarding (3–5 business days).

Blocker SLA commitments (for the MAP): engineering acknowledges a 24h triage window for audit gaps, 72h for model regressions root-cause analysis, and 7d for infrastructure fixes requiring hardware re-provisioning (we document fallbacks to mitigate).

I'll attach a short blocker-runbook-template.pdf that maps severity levels to owners and SLAs.

-Naomi
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

To: Alicia Mendez <alicia.mendez@sleepwellhealth.com>, SleepWell Health Procurement <procurement@sleepwellhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan@consulting-partner.io>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: MAP & acceptance runbook — final (includes blocker handling and KPI scoreboard)

Hi Alicia — thanks for the rapid review and the steering committee feedback. Attached are the finalized MAP workbook and the acceptance checklist. Summary of changes and final asks below so procurement has a single-page view:⠀

- Start date: Jun 15, 2026. End date: Jul 27, 2026. Final decision window: Jul 26–27.
- KPI scoreboard (pass thresholds):
   * Triage summarization: F1 >= 0.72 (on SleepWell clinical validation set), median latency (p50) <= 120ms, throughput target 5 TPS sustained.
   * Embeddings search: recall@10 >= 0.65, end-to-end search latency <= 180ms, index refresh < 90s.
   * Reliability: 99.5% availability during test window, no audit-log gaps > 10 minutes unaccounted.
   * Security: SOC2 evidence available + validated VPC peering and KMS test key usage.
- Blocker escalation flow: severity 1 (production-affecting) -> immediate page to on-call + procurement notified; severity 2 -> 24h triage; severity 3 -> tracked in engineering board with SLA 7 days for remediation. Owners mapped in workbook.
- Acceptance tests (examples):
   1) End-to-end sample run (1000 records) with golden outputs for summarization and scoring.
   2) Embedding batch compare vs baseline on recall and latency.
   3) Audit-log completeness test using synthetic events to validate retention and export.

Action items for SleepWell: confirm PHI presence in test set (yes/no), share dataset owner contact, and sign the evaluation addendum for extended audit retention (if needed).

If you approve, we'll convert the workbook to a mutual action plan and publish a shared timeline in the drive. I'm happy to join your steering call on Wednesday at 10:00 if that helps.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
